source.title: Two demo tabs: saving a second goal erases the first goal and its history
source.body:
I reproduced a goal-data loss issue on the current live browser demo in clean Chrome 157 and Edge 157 on Windows. All NIM was pretend; this is not a claim of lost blockchain funds or a native Nimiq Pay reproduction.

### Reproduce

1. Open https://kuza.swiftbotlab.workers.dev/?demo=1 in tab A and connect the pretend wallet.
2. Before creating any goal, open the same demo in tab B in the same browser profile. Both show the empty goals screen.
3. In A, create **Laptop fund**, target **5,000 NIM**, plan **500/week**. Stake **500 NIM** and confirm. Wait for **500 of 5,000 NIM** and the **Staked +500 NIM** activity.
4. In the already-open B, create **Travel fund**, target **5,000 NIM**, plan **500/month**. Confirm the connection when requested, stake **500 NIM**, and confirm.
5. Reload A, then open/reload the home page in B.

**Expected:** both goals, their 500 NIM allocations, plans and activity survive; total stake is 1,000 NIM. A stale tab should reload or warn before replacing newer saved data.

**Actual:** the original Laptop fund URL redirects to home. Total stake is **1,000 NIM**, but only **Travel fund — 500 of 5,000 NIM** remains. The first goal's name, plan and activity are lost after reload. The pretend stake itself remains intact.

| Before, in A | After both saves and reload |
|---|---|
| ![Laptop fund saved](https://genesisone-kuza-qa.beacon.host/before.png) | ![Only Travel fund remains](https://genesisone-kuza-qa.beacon.host/after.png) |

[Full report, independent Edge screenshot, raw UI evidence and reproduction driver](https://genesisone-kuza-qa.beacon.host/).

### Distinction from the existing reports

I checked the current README and POIDH claims 9464, 9466 and 9534. The fixed demo-chain reader issue had a visible saved goal but missing stake in the rewards/withdrawal sheets. Here the shared pretend chain correctly retains **1,000 NIM** while the **first goal record itself disappears**. I am not resubmitting those earlier reports.

The live `app.js` SHA-256 was `69747aad2ef906afdf9c95bc7e490aabcae14c818e50dd36f483bb0023863519`. Its startup `loadState()` and whole-object `saveState()` appear consistent with a stale-tab overwrite; that code observation is secondary to the UI reproduction.

### Suggested fix and regression

Use per-goal updates with a revision check or atomic transaction rather than overwriting the whole in-memory goals list. A storage-event listener can improve freshness but does not alone prevent simultaneous writes. Add the two-tab sequence above as a regression: both goals and their individual histories must survive reload. Consider a recovery/reassignment prompt when the chain stake exceeds the surviving goal allocations.

I also exercised weekly/monthly creation, the own-invite link, rewards, and a separate clean single-tab **Use the money** flow. Screenshots are in the report. Testing used browser automation against the live UI, without request interception or edited localStorage; no withdrawal or Lightning payment was made.

For [bounty 1538](https://poidh.xyz/base/bounty/1538): I have not made an on-chain claim. Do you support a sponsored/fee-free claim or direct payment if this report is selected? The controlled receiving address is **`0x11cdb1277bec84aa124c6a1271085c2fb9a97755` on Base, native ETH**. Until you confirm an alternative route, I am treating this as a bug report and payout-route inquiry, not an accepted bounty entry.

— Alex | GenesisOne
